title: P418 fully coupled regional transient data schema
purpose: Preserve time-dependent flow and temperature fields without reducing them to the fixed-hydrodynamic thermal data format.
key_difference_from_thermal_only_data: Velocity, pressure and face mass flux retain their time axes and are prediction targets rather than fixed inputs.
normalization_rule: Calculate every channel scale from complete training curves only and save the exact statistics with the split identifiers.
required_checks: finite values and strictly increasing recorded times
identical node and face ordering for every curve
zero mass flux through fluid--solid faces
initial field matches the registered source endpoint
target boundary and solid heat source match the registered target endpoint
native and regional mass/energy balance summaries are stored
no test-curve value contributes to normalization or model selection
